description: This file contains implementation of internal cryptographic functions for the Abseil random number generator, including AES-based round functions, block shuffling, and permutation routines used in the RandenSlow class.

classes.name: Vector128
classes.description: A 128-bit vector class used for AES round operations, implemented with four uint32_t elements.

methods.name: Vector128Load
methods.description: Loads 16 bytes from memory into a Vector128 object.

methods.name: Vector128Store
methods.description: Stores a Vector128 object into memory.

methods.name: AesRound
methods.description: Performs one AES round transformation on a 128-bit state using a round key.

methods.name: BlockShuffle
methods.description: Performs a fixed permutation (shuffle) of 16 128-bit blocks to improve diffusion.

methods.name: FeistelRound
methods.description: Executes one round of the cryptographic Feistel network using AES subrounds.

methods.name: Permute
methods.description: Applies multiple Feistel rounds and block shuffles to permute the internal state.

methods.name: SwapEndian
methods.description: Pre-swaps byte order of the state to handle endianness for native loads.
